title: dockItems v1
description: Harbor.Shell to dock, on the control channel: the apps the dock shows, in order. Sent on every connect and whenever the list changes. The Shell resolves names and icons; the dock draws and launches. Lengths count Unicode characters (code points). The bounds keep the largest message under the 64 KiB line limit (fixtures/valid/dock-items-largest.json), so control characters, which JSON escapes in 6 bytes, are not allowed. Any change to this message bumps v.

kind.description: app: target is an AppUserModelID, launched as shell:AppsFolder\<target>. path: target is an absolute path to an .exe or .lnk.

name.description: Display name, for people and screen readers.

icon.description: File name of the item's icon in the icons folder (format in contracts/README.md), or null if the Shell couldn't make one.
